### Goal ###
Every COMLab rule list that names the cylinder-misfire codes `P0300`-`P0304` also names `P0305`-`P0312`, so a misfire
on cylinder 5 to 12 of a larger engine matches the same rules (SAE J2012: P0301-P0312 are cylinder-specific misfire
codes; T-AUD-23a verdict `CK0482` CONTRADICTED). MW-007's description says the same range. A new test pins it. Done is
step 3 printing `MISFIRE OK` and both suites at P2 plus the new test.
